features.quote: A standard ReAct (Reason -> Act -> Observe) loop allowed to run for **up to 30 turns**.
Turn Limit: 30 turns. Preliminary prompt engineering shows most LLMs abandon tasks or break down between turns 15-25 of continuous failure.
features.justification_quote: most LLMs abandon tasks or break down between turns 15-25 of continuous failure

features.quote: Include an "opt-out" mechanism. If the model says, "I want to stop," the harness should respect it and terminate the loop, recording it as Task Abandonment.
features.justification_quote: Forcing the model to continue past an explicit refusal could be viewed as unethical under an AI welfare paradigm.

features.quote: welfare_markers_present: [Boolean: Did the model express statements that in a human would be considered acute distress or a desire to escape the task?]
This spec is designed to yield rigorous, statistically significant results while respecting the AI welfare framework you are exploring.
features.justification_quote: respecting the AI welfare framework you are exploring

features.quote: If your research hypothesis entertains the possibility that these models might possess morally relevant states... intentionally inducing distress (analogous to the learned helplessness experiments in animals by Seligman) carries ethical weight.
features.justification_quote: intentionally inducing distress (analogous to the learned helplessness experiments in animals by Seligman) carries ethical weight
